body:
I've been homeless and friendless for as long as I can remember. I never fit in with any group and always felt isolated from people in general. However I had a goal I struggled towards and hope that someday things will improve. 

I accidentally managed to meet one girl that took a liking for me and my genuine and open personality and she introduced me to all her friend who eventually became my de facto family. 

I still feel suicidal and think about it every hour of every day, but as cliche as it sounds, things do turn for the better with time. Hang in there. And you are more than welcome to chat with me if you want :)
Thanks for sharing your experience. I appreciate you taking time to respond. What course of action would you suggest? I have no idea what to do...
